title: Joint Optimization of Qubit Leasing and Quantum Circuit Distribution
summary: We consider an agent, who would like to execute a given quantum circuit using resources leased from a set of quantum computers (QCs) connected by a quantum network. For this purpose, the agent needs to make the following four key decisions: (i) how many qubits to lease from each QC, (ii) at which QCs to store different circuit qubits in different time slots, (iii) at which QC to execute each gate in the circuit, and (iv) when to teleport qubits between different pairs of QCs. We refer to this problem facing the agent as the joint qubit leasing and quantum circuit distribution (JQLQCD)…
